title: Payment Methods, Remittance and Balance Handling by Tier — Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms)
content:
Invoices on Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms) are paid by the methods the terms tier accepts. This card sets out, tier by tier, the accepted ways to pay, the card surcharge, how payments are applied, the returned-payment fee, the small-balance write-off and the credit-balance refund period.

### Accepted ways to pay and returned-payment fee

| Terms tier | Accepted ways to pay invoices | Surcharge on invoices paid by card (percent) | Fee for a returned ACH or check payment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | ACH, check, card | 0.0 | 25.0 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | ACH, check, card | 0.0 | 25.0 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | ACH, check, card, wire | 0.0 | 25.0 |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | ACH, check, wire | 0.0 | 25.0 |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | ACH, check, wire | 0.0 | 25.0 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | ACH, check, purchasing card (P-card) | 0.0 | 0.0 |

### Application, write-off and refund

| Terms tier | Payment without remittance detail is applied | Invoice numbers on the remittance decide application | Remaining invoice balance written off at or below (USD) | Credit balance refunded within (calendar days after a request) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | Oldest invoice first | Yes | 1.0 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | Oldest invoice first | Yes | 1.0 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | Oldest invoice first | Yes | 1.0 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | Oldest invoice first | Yes | 1.0 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | Oldest invoice first | Yes | 1.0 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | Oldest invoice first | Yes | 1.0 | 30 |

### Quick answers

- *Is card accepted on every tier?* No. Card is accepted on Net 15, Net 30 Standard and Net 30 Preferred; Net 45 Volume and Net 60 Enterprise accept ACH, check and wire; Net 30 Public Sector accepts ACH, check and purchasing card.
- *Is a returned-payment fee charged on Net 30 Public Sector?* The fee on that tier is 0.0.
- *Hypothetical balance:* an invoice left with $0.80 unpaid is at or below the $1.00 write-off figure; one left with $1.20 unpaid is above it.
